_meta.description: 333-stock canary universe (v3). Expanded from v2 (189) toward NIFTY 500 footprint (~339 tickers). Buckets retained: top100_diversified, banks, psu_utilities, cyclicals, pharma. New entries sourced from Day-15 merge-gate expansion against live stocks/market_metrics tables, capped to market_cap_cr >= 5,000 and excluding loss-makers + shadow tickers.

buckets.top100_diversified: Top ~100 NSE largecaps across diversified sectors (Nifty 100 ex-banks/PSUs/pharma/metals which are bucketed below)
buckets.psu_utilities: 20 PSU + utility names (power, oil-marketing, defence PSU, capital-goods PSU)
buckets.platform: Internet-platform + fintech-broker cohort (story-DCF eligible). Confidence is hard-capped at 50 — see StoryDcfBadge.
